prompts:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: faithful restoration of an existing StarLancer Sai spaceship UV texture atlas, sam_1.
Input image 1 is the edit target. Restore it at high resolution as one square flat texture atlas. Keep EVERY feature at exactly the original normalized coordinates and same size and silhouette: panel boundaries, red and white rising-sun artwork upper left, black Japanese brush characters, red vertical Japanese brush lettering lower middle, black and silver circular samurai emblem lower right, bronze panels, holes, vents, green panels and rivets. Trace the original symbols; do not replace or translate them. Do not add extra writing, screws, seams or decorations. No padding, border, perspective, rotation or 3D object.
Refine pixelated edges and recover realistic restrained fine scratches, chipped grey steel paint and worn bronze while retaining the original mottled weathering and subdued colours. Red paint remains red, white/grey paint remains light grey. Keep all existing scars and patina rather than cleaning the ship.
Glass: the dark green shapes at upper middle and lower left and the two thin horizontal green strips in the middle must retain their EXACT source outlines and frames, with a smooth dark desaturated green interior that has no painted reflections, clouds, streaks or speckles. Engine reflections will supply the highlights. The glass must fill its original frame without added inset triangles or smaller tapered panes.
This is a production base-colour atlas for the unchanged original UV layout. Keep recesses legible, avoid dramatic cast lighting and glossy highlights, no relief on printed insignia. All atlas edges align with source. Produce only the restored square atlas, crisp at 2048x2048 or higher.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: restoration of original StarLancer Sai spaceship UV texture sam_2.
Image 1 is the exact edit target, a small texture atlas. Produce the same square atlas faithfully at higher resolution, keeping every feature at exactly the same normalized coordinates, scale, proportions and outline. Restore the worn grey steel, dark grey panels, oxidized bronze left band, top red-and-white stripe, black eight-point shuriken insignia with its central vertical slot, red circular marking at lower left, and the two tall black slots inside the right-hand rectangle. Preserve original weathering, quiet military colours and sparse panel seams. Clean pixelation into crisp precise edges and restrained fine chipped paint without redesign.
Do not move, enlarge or rearrange anything. Do not add symbols, text, rivets, panels or borders. The shuriken and red circle are flat painted graphics, not sculpted metal. The red circular marking remains a circle with the original seam crossing it. No perspective, no rendered spaceship, no lighting gradients across the atlas. Subtle recessed vent interiors are allowed; printed marks must remain flat. Output only the square full-bleed atlas at 2048x2048 or higher.
